GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 300m made contact with another runner after being crowded and carried out. Rdr reported his mnt travelled comfortably through the middle stages in a trailing position, however when the runner he was trailing became unbalanced and lost ground near the 500m, this resulted in his mnt being steadied when awkwardly placed on heels and lost momentum. He added he shifted his mnt into clear running soon after straightening, but it was again hampered and following this incident it did not close the race off. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr std the mare came under pressure near the 500m and was inclined to lay out in the home straight, and he had recommended to connections to experiment with the application of head gear for its next race start. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr subsequentlyreported satisfaction with the post-race condition of the mare and the results of an endoscopic exam revealed no abnormalities, and the intention is to experiment with the application of head gear and step the mare up in distance for its next race start.
